summary: Full end-to-end testing of Bali landing page hero + lead form. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass for /api/leads (CRUD, validation). Frontend: All hero elements render within 1440x800 viewport without scrolling, 4-field form works, submit shows success toast + resets, header enquiry dialog opens with modal-prefixed form and submits successfully, hero CTA focuses lead-mobile, floating CTA appears after >120px scroll on desktop, mobile sticky bar visible on 390x844 with floating CTA hidden. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: WHATSAPP_LINK has empty number so wa.me href is https://wa.me/?text=... (no phone). Confirmed intentional per agent note, but should be populated before production.
Backend has no rate limiting on POST /api/leads — public endpoint can be spammed. Consider adding basic rate limit or captcha before launch.
Backend LeadCreate has no phone-format validation beyond min_length=8; consider regex validation to filter garbage submissions.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_-prefixed leads (TEST_Delhi, TEST_Mumbai) via automated tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_leads.py. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL or default preview URL. Base UI Select requires clicking SelectTrigger then option with data-testid *-month-option / *-travelers-option, with force=True. Lenis smooth scroll: use page.evaluate('window.scrollTo(...)') and wait ~1200ms. Focus check on hero CTA works after ~1200ms delay (700ms setTimeout in focusLeadForm).
